note: Lincoln County park on the Wisconsin River about 10 miles northwest of Merrill on Highway 107. The campground sits on a wooded strip above the river, joined by a footbridge over Ripley Creek to the day-use area, which has pavilions and a gravel boat landing with a kayak launch. The Ice Age Trail runs through the campground. Firewood is provided; don't bring your own. No ATV/UTV trail access. --Claude
